_comment: Cargo upgrade levels, in order (the first entry is level 0). resource_mult multiplies EVERY ore's cargo_cap (data/ores.json); general_mult multiplies the general hold for crafted items (inventory.general_capacity, default 30). Old files with a single capacity_mult still work: it is the fallback for both. Phase 5 crafting raises the level (gameplay::IInventory::setLevel).
